prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a tangible physical analog film photograph print resting flat on a scratched textured wooden table. Inside the matte off-white-bordered print is a medium close-up portrait of an adult woman with tousled shoulder-length jet-black hair, very pale skin with natural freckles, clear ice-blue eyes, a faint confident almost-smile, and a worn faded-emerald corduroy jacket over a dark T-shirt. The interior behind her is a softly blurred vintage cafe or bohemian apartment with warm wood and plants. Use soft natural side window light. Make the image feel like a slightly expired Kodak Portra 400 35mm print with heavy natural grain, warm earthy desaturation, subtle green-magenta tint, matte paper texture, and slightly worn corners. No readable text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, glossy digital paper, clean perfect edges
